actions: Translate and include all non-English comments in the summary (glosses provided).
Show theme priorities both raw and age-re-weighted; do not present raw counts as 'what residents want'.
Recommend a second, multilingual paper / door-to-door round targeted at 55+ residents (Seabreeze L06).
Flag repeated identical wording; Community Engagement to confirm whether submissions are independent.
Hold the consultation summary (D15) for HC7 sign-off before it is handed to KHB as design input.

findings.text: Online channel supplied 160/214 responses (74.8%); 115 of them from under-45s. Seabreeze saw the same skew (L06).

Residents 65+ gave 25 responses (11.7%) although they are the main users of the active ageing centre; under-45s gave 121 (56.5%). Estate age profile: NOT FOUND in pack, so true representativeness cannot be computed.

19 non-English responses (zh 10, ms 6, ta 3) all come via paper/town hall (18 from residents 45+) and are about seniors, lifts or noise. An English-only summary would drop 11 of 36 active-ageing comments and 6 of 37 lift/access comments.

Theme priority by raw count: ['Childcare', 'Communication & trust', 'Lifts & barrier-free access', 'Active ageing / seniors']; with each age band weighted equally: ['Childcare', 'Active ageing / seniors', 'Lifts & barrier-free access', 'Communication & trust']. Order CHANGES under re-weighting - report both.
Only 25 distinct comment texts across 214 responses - heavy repetition; check for template or campaign submissions before weighting.
Mean rating by age band: {'25-34': 3.19, '65+': 3.28, '55-64': 3.24, '18-24': 3.48, '45-54': 3.45, '35-44': 2.65}. Town hall drew about 40 residents (EDC 4.5) and gave 31 responses.
